flows:
Navigate to https://quotes.toscrape.com/random then Store the quote text as 'quote' and store the author name as 'author'.
Verify that an author name is visible on the page.

remark: analyze: The author name is stored as {{author}}.
assert: An author name is visible on the page.

summary:
Retrieved the randomly displayed quote and its author from Quotes to Scrape.
Saved the quote text: “You believe lies so you eventually learn to trust no one but yourself.”
Saved the author name: Marilyn Monroe.
Confirmed that the author name was visible on the page.
